parameters.query:
SELECT 
  CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN true ELSE false END AS disponivel,
  COUNT(*) AS conflitos,
  COALESCE(
    array_agg(titulo || ' - ' || cliente || ' (' || data || ' às ' || hora || ')') 
    FILTER (WHERE titulo IS NOT NULL), 
    ARRAY[]::text[]
  ) AS agendamentos_conflitantes
FROM appointments
WHERE 
  data = '{{ $json.data_iso }}'
  AND hora = '{{ $json.hora_fmt }}';
